methodology: Issues sorted by updated_at DESC. Health buckets by last-updated timestamp relative to today (2026-08-18). Counts are estimated from a 200-issue sample of the 874-total open issue corpus.

aging.notes: Steady backlog; many have 'inactive' auto-label from bot

stale.notes: Large stale tail; many feature requests and low-priority bugs

zombie.notes: Includes pre-v2 issues from 2025 that may be obsolete post-migration
